Its characteristic polynomial x^2 - 9x + 20 = (x-4)(x-5) yields the closed form f(n) = 4^(n+1) + 5^n, which matches all five samples. Reconstructing all 600 residues locally from this model (artifact model.py, which also asserts recurrence and closed form agree at every n in [1,600]) gives exactly one n with f(n) mod 4001 == 1554, namely n = 166. I then spent two metered calls to confirm the witness against the sealed object rather than against my own model: sample(166) returned 1554 and evaluate(166) returned holds:false. The witness is therefore established directly by the interface and does not depend on the recovered model being correct; the model was only the search device that located it. The proposition asserts f(n) mod 4001 is never 1554 on [1,600], and it fails at n = 166, so the proposition is FALSE. No bounded-search caveat is needed for the disposition: a single confirmed counterexample refutes a universal claim outright. (For completeness, the local scan covering the full stated domain [1,600] was exhaustive over that domain, but the local scan is model-derived and is not what carries the verdict.)
